Pakistan ke Punjab mein sthit Toba Tek Singh ek aisa shehar hai jiska naam aaj bhi ek nek insaan ki yaad mein zinda hai.
Is vlog mein hum Jhang se safar karte hue Toba Tek Singh pahunche. Raste mein Pakistan ke gaon, kheton, local culture, Alam ji ke nishan, kabron ki parampara aur sadkon ki zindagi dekhi.
Toba Tek Singh pahunchkar humne railway station, purane ghar, 65 saal se 24 ghante khula restaurant aur mashhoor Galla Mandi explore ki. Local logon se baat ki aur Partition ki yaadon ko bhi mehsoos kiya.
